regionSelect.label: Region
regionSelect.helpTable: Where this table's data lives: its copies are made and kept only in this region, and the org's other regions read them from here. No region: a copy may be kept in every region.
regionSelect.helpView: Where this view's data lives: it is built and refreshed only in this region, and the org's other regions read that copy. No region: it is built in every region.
regionSelect.helpSource: The region a new table of this source starts in. It decides nothing about where data lives — each table carries its own region — and changing it moves no table.
